object of the act performed by Brahmāṇī

items.question: Who holds the actual agency of creation, Brahmāṇī or Brahmā?
premises: Brahmāṇī performs the act of creation.
Brahmā's lack of creative agency applies at all times.
items.inference: Creative agency belongs exclusively to Brahmāṇī and never to Brahmā.
items.plain_english: Brahmāṇī performs creation, but Brahmā never does.
